title: feat(pm): round-open.mjs and check-handover --inflight read the round-open mutex and the in-flight check
body:
Part of #35237 — slice 4 (the in-flight check and the round-open mutex, with the `area-lease.md` pointer) plus carrier items 1 and 2 of comment 7181970862. The card stays open for slice 7 and carrier item 3 (serial behind #37064 on `dispatch-gates.mjs`).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Rule-change: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:这是车队内部工具,席位开轮前和派发前要手工重打的两段读法,现在各有一个只读脚本。
- 属于「产品区域与定级规则落地」专题下车队技能整理的第六步:把每次重打的散文步骤换成脚本,替各执行席省掉重复读板。
- 读错只会让席位多等一轮或多看一张卡,脚本什么都不写,删掉指针行即可撤回。
- 要你做的一件事:这条改了受管的规则文件和守卫脚本,需要你的审批后由席位落地。

## What changes

Each pointer line keeps its rule sentence and names the reader as its reading; only the retyped procedure moved into the script (the done-when form of `Release:` 7017468070).

| Rule line on `main` | Retyped procedure it carried | Now read by |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `seat-lifecycle.md` 〈开轮互斥〉 line 5, readings 1–4 (lines 6–10) | find the seat post, its newest stand-down brief and the newest marker after it; walk the lane's `pm:dispatched` ∪ `pm:queue` cards for the newest same-seat claim by another session; `git ls-remote` card by card for a push since the brief; walk the closed lane cards newest-updated first | `scripts/pm/round-open.mjs` (new). Line 5 names it; line 9 loses only `(逐卡 \`git ls-remote\`)`, the rule 「推即认领,欠一条 `Claim:`」 stays |
| `area-lease.md` line 31 「开轮互斥读法照 `seat-lifecycle.md`」 | the same reading, for an area session | the same script: 「开轮互斥照 `seat-lifecycle.md`,现读 `round-open.mjs`」 |
| `SKILL.md` 〈车道与域〉 「派发前在飞检查:读 `pm:dispatched` 卡认领评论申报的文件面,本地求交」 and `execution-duties.md` line 42 (the `ui/**` remainder's in-flight intersection) | read each `pm:dispatched` claim's `File surface:` line, expand it, intersect it with the dispatch's surface by hand | `scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs --inflight --paths=… [--card=N]`. `execution-duties.md` line 42 names it. `SKILL.md` is outside this claim's file surface, so its line is unchanged (see Acceptance notes) |

**`round-open.mjs`** — `--seat LANE#N --session S [--own S,…] [--post N] [--intake …] [--round-minutes 60]`. Reading 1 is the newest stand-down brief on the seat post, recognised on its headline from the nine spellings measured on the live posts (`## Clock-out`, `Clock-out brief`, `## 收班简报`, `Stand-down brief`, `Shift end`, …). Reading 2 is the newest comment after it that carries this seat's signature from a session outside `--own`. Reading 3 is the newest same-seat `Claim:` by another session on EVERY open `pm:dispatched` ∪ `pm:queue` card updated inside the window, on the intake or off it (a p0/p1 card is taken from any area). Reading 3 also covers a push: one `git ls-remote --heads` for the whole board, intersected locally with the `claude/issue-N…` heads of every open `pm:dispatched` card and of the intake's cards (the intake is the post title's `area:*` / `epic #N`, through `seatIntakeKeys`); each matched head's commit is read for its committer date and its `Claude-Session:` trailer. A push counts as a claim (推即认领) when the card's newest claim is this seat's, or, on the intake only, when the card has no claim. Reading 4 is the first closed card, on the intake or off it, carrying this seat's claim. It is timed by that session's newest comment on the card, because a merge closes a card and is no act of the seat.

A foreign session's activity yields the seat when it is newer than the brief and under one round old (exit 5). "One round" defaults to contract-review.md's 「一轮(约 60 分钟)」, and the self-test pins that phrase. An unread session counts as foreign. A brief newer than every activity clears at once (简报即最新事件 ⇒ 立即坐席). Every read is bounded by that window: a card not updated inside it buys no thread read. Exits: 0 CLEAR · 2 usage · 3 prerequisite · 4 INCOMPLETE · 5 YIELD. The footer names five unread legs: the maintainer's summon, the lease table (pass its sessions with `--own`), non-convention branches, the real push time, and the touch readings after a clear mutex. The self-test has 37 cases across 6 pinned batteries, with the handshake, and is wired into `check:pm-prior-rulings` beside `card-pick.mjs`.

**`check-handover --inflight`** reads every open `pm:dispatched` card's thread through (a)'s own paging, now one helper (`readDispatched`). For each card it takes the NEWEST `Claim:` that no `Release:` follows, plus every later `Claim amendment`, read in thread order: a fence removes only what was declared at or before it, so the newest declaration wins. It reads their `File surface:` lines, both the one-line form and the measured multi-line form (an empty value with list items under it). From those lines it keeps the code spans that are paths, with braces expanded, minus what a `Not …` / `No …` / `⛔ …` clause fences (a `No changes outside …` clause is surface). It then intersects them with `--paths` (`meetKind`: literal paths, directories, globs read root-relative). A claimed bare file name reads as that name anywhere; a claimed path fragment (`lanes/director.md`, `references/contract-review.md`) reads as a whole-segment suffix, and a dispatch `DIR` and `DIR/**` answer it alike. A dispatched bare name is the root file. A claimed bare name against a dispatch directory or `DIR/**` is listed NOT COMPARED, and the clear line states that a deeper fragment and a glob fragment are never judged. Exits: 0 clear · 2 OVERLAP (each meeting pair named) · 4 no verdict · 5 no readable surface meets, but a claim's surface names no path. The self-test grew from 67 to 92 cases, with an `inflight:` floor of 24. Per the ruling in its header (「Local, by ruling」, 6162084315 letter A), no workflow runs this script, and its self-test stays unwired as before.

**Carrier item 1** — `record-recognisers.mjs` `HANDOFF_TARGET` now reads `repo:NAME#N` (a dotted repo name included) and `epic:#N#k`, beside `l2-review#N` / `review#N` and the retired `domain:LANE#N`. It has two new self-test rows, with controls (`repo:objectstack`, `repo:#2`, `epic:#35205`, `epic:35205#1` stay unreadable), and the battery floor rises 17 → 19. **Carrier item 2** — the `card-pick.mjs` docblock and its lane-ownership footer leg no longer say a `domain:*` card outside the seat's lane may not be claimed. They say `domain:*` reads as file ownership only (lanes are seats and epics), and that a cloud card or a security card may still not be claimed. A new CLI-battery case covers this (floor 12 → 13). `execution-duties.md` line 50, which explained the stale footer, now states the rule alone. `check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`'s comment names 〈车道与域〉.

**Read first** (by risk): `scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs` `HANDOFF_TARGET` (a guard instrument, Tier H); `scripts/pm/round-open.mjs` `mutexVerdict` and `readMutex`'s push leg; `scripts/pm/check-handover.mjs` `surfaceTokens` / `surfacesMeet`.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/card-pick.mjs --self-test` → `✓ card-pick self-test: 63 cases pass across 8 batteries` (was 62)
- Ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`. Each mutation was proven on disk (anchor 1 → 0, blob moved) and restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty:
  1. `HANDOFF_TARGET` back to the domain-only arm: exit 1, 2 of 466 red (both new rows).
  2. card-pick footer back to 「against your lane」: exit 1, 1 of 63 red.
  3. `surfaceTokens` with no exclusion clause: exit 1, 3 of 85 red.
  4. claimed bare name meeting a `DIR/**`: exit 1, 1 red.
  5. no exit 5 for unread surfaces: exit 1, 1 red.
  6. `mutexVerdict` ignoring the brief: exit 1, 1 of 32 red.
  7. every session read as own: exit 1, 4 red.
  8. a push on another seat's card counted: exit 1, 1 red.
  9. the window bound on thread reads deleted: exit 1, 1 red.
- Fix rounds 1–2 (contract review 7214100600, delta 7214788709), same tool, each restored to the HEAD blob: S1 open listing back to the intake → 3 of 36 red; S1 closed listing back to the intake → 1 red; N1 own filter removed → 1 red; S2 every fence over the final union → 1 of 90 red; S3 suffix arm removed → 2 red; N4 not-compared listing disabled → 1 red; S4 heads matched to the intake only → 2 of 37 red; S4 holder check letting an unclaimed off-intake card count → 1 red; S5 `DIR/**` not read as its directory → 1 of 92 red; N8 single-segment directory skipped → 1 red.

</details>

<details><summary>Live runs</summary>

- `round-open.mjs --seat repo:objectstack#8 --session session_01ASNY8UcT2uJmgTyCPnMiMZ` → exit 0 CLEAR. Seat post #37865; no brief; reading 2 is this session's seat audit; intake `area:fleet`; 5 card threads and 3 head commits read.
- `round-open.mjs --seat repo:objectstack#3 --session session_01ASNY8UcT2uJmgTyCPnMiMZ`, as a probe from outside that seat → exit 5 YIELD. It names two same-seat claims written inside the round by seat 3's area sessions (#36734, #35528). A seat-3 session would pass those sessions with `--own`.
- `check-handover.mjs --inflight` with this PR's own surface and `--card=35237` → exit 5. 36 open `pm:dispatched` cards were read, with 35 held claims. None meets. #37767 and #37766 carry prose-only surfaces and are named.
- `check-handover.mjs --inflight --paths=scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs,ui/packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx,docs/adr/0162-x.md` → exit 2. It names 5 meeting claims, among them #37064 (`dispatch-gates.mjs`), #37718 (a multi-line surface) and #37817 (the glob `docs/adr/0162-*.md`).

</details>

<details><summary>Gates at `030220ea`, re-run at `ab7e76dc`</summary>

- At `ab7e76dc` the same 80 families were derived and re-run: 74 exit 0, 6 exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET = NOT MEASURED (the same six, built dist), none red; `dispatch-gates --ran` → `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 80 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 74 run, 6 NOT-MEASURED (6 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3).` (families 1–52 ran in one detached run, 53–80 in a resumed one after a session pause.)

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` (no paths; 9 paths against the merge base, after merging `origin/main` 02ed8408) derived 80 families. All 80 ran, with each exit captured before any pipe. Results: 73 exit 0 on the first pass; 6 exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET, read as NOT MEASURED (`check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`); and 1 exit 1. Those six read built dist, and the diff touches no package, so no closure was built. The exit 1 was `check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs`, which refused with `spawnSync node ETIMEDOUT` while running a sibling's self-test under load average 7; re-run alone, it exits 0: `✓ check-self-test-workflow-commands: no self-test CI runs prints a line the Actions runner would parse as a workflow command.`

- Outside it: `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` 0; `npx eslint --no-inline-config` on the four edited scripts and the new one, 0.
- `check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 35237 --paths` over this surface reads 641 hit lines. None of the lines this PR edits cites a ruling. The one ruling next to an edit is check-handover's 「Local, by ruling」 (6162084315, letter A), and `--inflight` keeps it: no workflow runs the script.

## Acceptance notes

- `SKILL.md` 〈车道与域〉's in-flight line names no reader. `SKILL.md` was fenced out of this claim's surface. The pointer belongs on that line (「派发前在飞检查:… 本地求交、不另发查询」 → add 「现读 `check-handover.mjs --inflight`」); carrier: the seat.
- The `Contract-review-handoff:` TEMPLATE still prints the placeholder `l2-review#N|domain:LANE#N` (inside angle brackets). The self-test pins it verbatim in `references/contract-review.md`, which is outside this surface. The reader now accepts the live seat spellings, and the template's placeholder should follow in that file; carrier: the seat.
- 「非豁免 `Claim:`」 (reading 4) is read as a claim of this seat. The 不占席 chains (review, director) never carry an executing seat's number, so the seat filter already leaves them out. No other exemption is written in the rule text.
- The in-flight surface reader is new code, not a borrowed one. `dispatch-gates.mjs` holds a private `FILE_SURFACE_KEY_LINE` for one effort check, and that file is serial behind #37064, so nothing was exported from it.
- A push counts as a claim only on a lane card that this seat claims or that nobody claims, so another seat's push on a shared area (`area:fleet` has two seats) never yields this one.
- `area-lease.md` line 37 spells `overlap-check.mjs` without its `scripts/pm/` prefix. The other pointers already spell script names bare, and this deletion pays for the new pointer's bytes.
- Byte ratchet: `seat-lifecycle.md` 9054 → 9054 (ceiling 9070), `area-lease.md` 6577 → 6584 (ceiling 6586), `execution-duties.md` 22301 → 22281 (ceiling 22307). Line counts unchanged (99, 66, 207). No ceiling row moved.
- L2: this PR moves `.claude/**` rule text and edits a guard instrument (`record-recognisers.mjs`), so it lands at Tier H after a contract-tier review; the seat routes both.
